chunks: Indeed, Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, sees only good.
ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq say about how Allah perceives good?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) to elucidate the concept of *al-Hasan* (the Good) as an absolute divine attribute, distinguishing God's perspective from human perception of events. This highlights the Shia theological principle that all divine decrees, whether perceived as joy or sorrow by creation, are inherently rooted in wisdom and ultimate benefit. It serves as a foundation for understanding *al-Hikmah* (divine wisdom) in the context of *al-Qada' wa al-Qadar* (divine decree).
